objectiveFull: Re-review (round 2) of fixes to the reader engine of "Water Born", a cinematic 3D web storybook (Vite + TypeScript strict + Three.js 0.186 + raw Web Audio, static GitHub Pages site). Review only the fix commit range given. Round 1 findings and what was done (see docs/plan.md "Review dispositions", engine round 1): (a) MAJOR src/director.ts speak(): toggling narration off or turning the page during the narration-timing / audio load left the page stuck in mode 'intro' or still started the clip — fixed by re-checking `r === this.reading && this.voice` after each await and, in finally, falling back to mode 'timed' when the page is still current and still 'intro'; (b) MAJOR src/audio/mixer.ts setAmbience: stop() on a loop source that was never started threw InvalidStateError out of Book.onTurnStart — fixed by deleting the entry first and only stopping a source whose buffer was set (buffer is assigned immediately before start()); (c) music fade-out pause guard (A→B→C); per-page gate/skipPushIn moved from Director into the Reading object; TITLE_SPREAD and nearestPage helpers; revisited pages zeroed on turn start so they arrive blank and re-ink; one character-index home (pages.ts now uses blockStarts from content/book.ts); timeOf moved to content/narration-timing.ts with tests; flick velocity ignored after a 90 ms pause; cached picture grain/leather/endpaper; group.localToWorld instead of updateMatrixWorld; cards re-laid out only on size change; turn hint placed/animated only while shown; push-in texture disposed after use. Check that these fixes are correct and complete and introduce no new defects (e.g. a reading that can stall, double narration, a gate that never resolves, broken disposal of shared textures — the endpaper material and cover texture are intentionally shared and never disposed; the cinema texture is now disposed after each push-in). Do NOT re-raise these dispositioned items: scripts/narration.ts pageText duplicate (rejected, closed audio pipeline); director.ts size; boot() lacking a top-level catch; import.meta.env making surfaces/director untestable under node --test; phone-landscape small text (open item); ticker tweens not cancellable by design (callers check a token). Verification already run: npm run verify (typecheck + 17 tests) green, vite build green, headless-Chromium walkthrough in self-read and narrated modes with zero console errors.

findings.issue: setVoice only handles 'voice'/'timed'; a reading still in 'intro' during the first narration load stays blank with taps swallowed (as skipPushIn) until the in-flight timing/mp3 request settles when voice is turned off, and an off->on toggle during playNarration's load leaves the page in silent 'timed' mode while the HUD shows narration on.
findings.fix: Record that the push-in has finished (a flag on Reading), then let setVoice(false) move such an 'intro' reading straight to 'timed' and setVoice(true) leave the in-flight speak alone or restart it.

findings.issue: spokenChars' JSDoc is left orphaned directly above timeOf's JSDoc; spokenChars (line 21) is now undocumented.
findings.fix: Move the line-9 comment to sit directly above export function spokenChars.

findings.issue: With the ping animation only on .turn-hint.on, removing .on cancels the animation at once, so the hint snaps to a static scale-1, 0.7-alpha ring for its 0.5 s opacity fade (it previously faded mid-ping).
findings.fix: Keep animation on .turn-hint with animation-play-state: paused, and set running on .on, or accept the pop.

findings.issue: Disposing the push-in texture after play is safe even if two plays overlap: the map===tex guard keeps a newer map. The shared endpaper/cover materials sit on rigid leaf 0 and the back board, which refreshWindow never disposes.

timeOf was inserted between spokenChars and its JSDoc; line 9's 'How many characters of a block have been spoken by time t' now sits above timeOf's own JSDoc, and spokenChars (line 21) is undocumented.
findings.fix: Move the line-9 comment to directly above `export function spokenChars`.

findings.issue: Each play() now disposes its own texture after fade-out (lines 46-48), so the leading `this.mesh.material.map?.dispose()` is redundant; it could only act during an overlapping play, where it would free a texture still on screen. Two disposal sites for one texture.
findings.fix: Delete line 28; keep the end-of-play dispose as the single owner.

findings.issue: edgeTexture() still hand-rolls createElement('canvas') + getContext('2d')!, duplicating the canvas() helper this commit exported from pages.ts and adopted in backdrop.ts and reflection.ts; it also skips the helper's null-context throw.
findings.fix: Use `const [c, ctx] = canvas(8, 64);` imported from './pages.ts' (no import cycle).

findings.issue: Turning narration off then on while the page's first clip loads: setVoice(true) (director.ts:424) skips because mode is 'intro', playNarration returns undefined (superseded by the off), and the finally fallback sets 'timed', so the page reads silently while the HUD shows narration on; the toggle-on is lost for that page.
findings.fix: In the finally fallback, after setting r.mode = 'timed', add `if (this.voice && !r.gate) void this.speak(r, Math.floor(r.clock));`. It cannot loop: failures set 'timed' in catch first, and each supersession needs another user toggle.

findings.issue: The fade-out pause timer only checks `this.currentMusic !== oldId`, not whether it is still the latest timer for that track. With A->B->A->B inside 4 s, the first timer pauses A while A is still fading from the last switch, cutting it at audible volume.
findings.fix: Keep one pending pause timer per track: clearTimeout the track's earlier timer before scheduling a new one and when the track is restarted (one mutable pauseTimer field on Track).
